name: Gohoushi Kissa ~Tenshi-tachi ni Omakase~ Airi Hen
original_name: ご奉仕喫茶～天使達におまかせ～ あいり編
source:
Souji is working at a cafe with Airi. There is a unique system that a boy and a girl work together in a pair. As they help each other, they start to love each other.... What will be waiting for them at the end of their erotic life...?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090328193029/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_49/products_id/1004214]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
宗司和愛理在一家咖啡館工作。
店裡有一套特別制度：員工必須一男一女結成搭檔，一起工作。
兩人在互相扶持間漸生情愫……
在他們情慾生活的盡頭，等待著他們的會是什麼？

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090328193029/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_49/products_id/1004214]Eroge Shop[/url]]
